result.summary: The page structure is largely sound, but the 'Popular right now' section has a stuck loading spinner overlaying an already-rendered image, and the favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently with one having poor contrast. The first 'Fastest near you' thumbnail also renders as a washed-out placeholder compared to its siblings.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image even though the image appears fully rendered underneath, suggesting the loading state never resolves/hides.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner on the image's onLoad/onError event, and ensure the loading overlay is removed once the asset finishes decoding.

issues.description: The favorite heart button on the second 'Popular right now' card uses a dark/opaque circular background with a dark outline heart, giving very low contrast, while the card above uses a white circle with a dark heart. The two controls look like different components.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button to a single style (e.g., semi-transparent white circle with dark heart) and ensure the icon meets contrast requirements over any image background.

issues.description: The first 'Fastest near you' thumbnail (Green Bowl Poké) renders on a flat light-gray background unlike the other dark, photo-style cards, making it look like a broken/placeholder image.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent image asset or apply the same background treatment/gradient overlay across all carousel thumbnails.

issues.description: Interactive icon-only controls (notification bell, favorite hearts) have no visible labels; if accessible names are missing they will be unusable with screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Add aria-labels such as 'Notifications' and 'Add to favorites: <restaurant name>' to all icon-only buttons.
